goal: Cross only the minimum human-authority membrane required to submit the already-built Changed Method Navigator as a free hidden JetBrains Marketplace probe, while preserving private source and avoiding public discoverability until separately authorized.

decisions.prompt: Authorize an initial JetBrains Marketplace upload with Hidden enabled, while keeping public/unhidden release unauthorized.
decisions.reversibility: Hidden initial release can be removed while hidden; later unhiding is a separate irreversible discoverability decision.

decisions.prompt: Choose the Vendor profile identity and immutable Vendor ID under which the plugin will be published.
decisions.reversibility: Vendor ID is not editable later; public name/email/website can be updated later.

decisions.prompt: Declare trader or non-trader status for the Vendor profile based on the Center-holder's actual legal/commercial status.
decisions.reversibility: Treat as a legal-status declaration; do not infer automatically.

decisions.prompt: Review and accept the JetBrains Marketplace Developer Agreement if willing to proceed with upload.
decisions.reversibility: Legal acceptance cannot be delegated to the machine.

decisions.prompt: Choose/approve the Developer EULA or license posture for the plugin. Preserve private source unless the Center-holder deliberately chooses an open-source license and source-link obligation.
decisions.reversibility: License/EULA changes can have legal and IP consequences; machine may prepare language but may not choose the posture.
decisions.recommendedPosture: private-source/proprietary Developer EULA for the hidden probe unless deliberately changed

machineActions.action: Insert the chosen Vendor identity into plugin metadata without inventing optional contact fields.
Prepare the selected Developer EULA/license artifact for review/upload.
Rebuild the plugin and rerun real PSI tests, IntelliJ SDK build, Plugin Verifier, and packaged-artifact inspection.
Keep the probe free, omit paid/freemium product descriptor, and set Hidden for the initial upload.
Assemble the verified ZIP plus Marketplace description, change notes, icon, tags, and hidden-release configuration.
Once the Center-holder has completed identity/legal actions in the JetBrains account, upload the verified package as Hidden. Do not unhide or monetize without separate authority.
After Marketplace approval, preserve the direct hidden-plugin link and define the smallest independent-user observation needed to resolve Market Truth.
